_readme: Everything on the display is controlled from this file. Edit it on github.com, commit, and the screen picks up the change within 10 minutes. Keep it valid JSON: double quotes, commas between items, no trailing comma.

weather._readme: Boulder, CO. To move the location: look up your point at https://api.weather.gov/points/LAT,LON and copy gridId/gridX/gridY into 'gridpoint' as 'BOU/54,74'.

station._readme: The ATOC rooftop station feed published by willychap.github.io/weather. 'url' must be a JSON array of readings with datetime/temp_f/humidity/... fields.

announcements.title: Welcome to ATOC
announcements.body: The Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences studies weather, climate, air quality, and the oceans — from the boundary layer over Boulder to the circulation of the global atmosphere.

announcements.title: Find us
announcements.body: Main office: SEEC building, CU Boulder East Campus. Department website: atoc.colorado.edu

announcements.title: Prospective students
announcements.body: We offer undergraduate degrees and PhD/MS programs in atmospheric and oceanic sciences. Graduate applications are typically due in December.

announcements.title: This slide is editable
announcements.body: Anything posted here shows up on the lobby screen within ten minutes — seminars, deadlines, field campaign updates, congratulations.
